annotations.title: Leave a message for a business or organization

description: Drop the user's feedback (a suggestion, a problem or a compliment) into the private suggestion box of any business or organization on SuggestionBox.tips. Private between the user and them. Confirm the wording with the user before sending. Give the website when you know it; otherwise its name and city.

city.description: City, needed when there is no website.

email.description: Optional. The user's email, only if they want to hear back.

ref.description: Optional order or booking number the message is about.

text.description: The message, in the user's words.

name: leave_message
title: Leave a message for a business or organization
